text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The day of my debut race has finally 
arrived. With today's victory... I shall 
become the new shining star the audience 
has been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
With that grand declaration, showing my 
majestic back to my awestruck attendants— 
I marched forward onto the battlefield!
